en: Black‑and‑white view of a historic hilltop complex with a large Gothic cathedral featuring multiple tall spires and an attached castle-like building above a riverside town. In the foreground a paddle steamer labeled "WETTIN" travels along a broad river, with smaller boats and quays on the near bank. At the foot of the hill are 19th‑century houses and industrial buildings, one with a sign on the roof. The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
